description: This file defines the Radios class, which extends the Named class, for managing a collection of radio button options in a form element within the Goteo project. It handles initializing options, creating Radio objects, and setting properties like 'checked' and 'id'.

classes.name: Radios
classes.description: Represents a group of radio button options for a super form element, allowing initialization of options and setting of the selected value.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Radios object, processes the options array, creating Radio objects and setting their checked state.
